questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy under review, the Climate Change Risk and Adaptation Strategy, clearly identifies climate action as its core purpose. The policy outlines a plan of action for the next four years, enabling the Council to prepare for the long-term risks of climate change. It aims to integrate climate change risk management and adaptation into the Council's efforts. The policy has four overarching objectives, all of which are directly related to climate change: planning for and managing the risks of climate change, seeking partnerships for climate change adaptation, using the natural environment to build adaptive capacity, and encouraging future-proofing design. The policy also identifies 42 climate change risks to the Council and includes 25 key directions to assist the Council in achieving a climate-adapted Maroondah. Therefore, it is evident that climate action is the core purpose of this policy.

quote.content: It will guide Council’s efforts to integrate climate change risk management and adaptation. This Strategy lays out a plan of action for the next four years enabling Council to prepare for the long-term risks of climate change.

The documents also emphasize the importance of early planning for climate change to help reduce impacts and support a proactive approach to managing the risks associated with climate change. The documents further outline the local government's planned actions, including managing the risks of climate change, seeking opportunities for partnerships and collaboration that support climate change adaptation, using the natural environment to build adaptive capacity, and encouraging future-proofing design. These actions are aimed at achieving a climate-adapted community.
